TEXT:
At that moment, the lovely mood around us was 
completely dispelled by the ringing of my phone.
Ayase's ticked off now, isn't she?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...Onii-san, aren't you picking up your phone?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-Ah...

Pressured by Ayase's threatening attitude, I 
checked my phone's inbox... It's from Kanako?!

Her absolutely awful timing was making my head 
hurt. As for what she wants--

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
Hey Manager, you free? 'Course you're free. I need 
some advice.
--is what she said.

The way she's using me like some servant, I wonder 
if she's misunderstood something?

Anyway, I replied saying I'm busy right now but I'll 
hear her out later, and closed my phone.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: ...So, who was it from?

At that moment, I swear I could hear the very air 
freezing around us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Um, Ayase-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Hey, Onii-san, won't you tell me?

Don't say that with a smile like that on your face! 
It's scary!
...Well, it's nothing I need to hide anyway.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's from Kanako. Want to see?

As I said that, I took out my phone and presented 
it to Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Ah, no, I wouldn't...

With that, Ayase pushed my phone back to me 
with a troubled expression.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You sure?

I think it'd be better for her to clear up any doubts 
if it's bothering her that much.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: It's okay. I trust you, Onii-san.
It didn't seem like it just a moment ago though.
Well, if Ayase says so, I guess it's fine.

I put my phone away and tried to improve the 
mood again.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
Oh, right! There's an ice cream stand with delicious 
ice cream near here!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'll go buy some, then.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
No, I'll go by myself. You can just wait here, 
Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, I should go with--

Ayase raised a finger to silence my lips, giving me a 
radiant smile.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
It's okay. Just promise you'll welcome me back 
with a smile once I return, okay?

As Ayase said that, she rushed out of the park 
without waiting for my reply.

Well, Ayase is more at home in Odaiba than I am, 
so the best decision here is to leave it to her.

...Still, as a guy, this is rather vexing, I better reflect 
on this when I get back home.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Sorry to keep you waiting.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, that was quick... Wait, why only one?

I asked out of curiosity as I saw her carrying only 
one ice cream in her hand.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: I thought we might share it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Huh?

Following which, she took a bite of the ice cream. 
You're adorable like that, but didn't you just say 
something very odd, Ayase-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Here you go, Onii-san.

At that moment, I must've died at least three times. 
I mean, I could see my whole life pass before my 
eyes.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: U-Um, Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, it's nothing. What were you saying again?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
I was just saying that we should eat this ice cream 
together.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
I-I'm often eating ice cream with Kirino, but... as a 
couple, is it that strange?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I-It's not strange at all!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Thank goodness...

Ayase was still holding the ice cream out towards 
me.
No other choice then, I'm taking a bite.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It's sweet...

I think I wanted to say something more, but that 
notion was blown away instantly.
I mean, this is... 'that', isn't it? An indirect kiss...!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: It's okay if you want some more.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: *gasp*

That's when I noticed. I couldn't help but notice. 
There's some ice cream stuck to her cheek...!!
I-Is she doing that on purpose?!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Hm? Is something wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, there's some... on your cheek...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: Eh? Ah!

As I pointed it out, Ayase got a bit flustered and 
hurriedly wiped her face with a handkerchief.
Nope. I regret nothing, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: P-Please say that sooner, geez...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: A-Ah, sorry...

I tried to calm my frantically beating heart while 
eating the rest of the ice cream with Ayase.

Right now, anyone who saw us would think we're 
madly in love... Well, it's the truth though.
